svg.title: LangGraph medical agent workflow
svg.desc: State graph showing how medical AI agents — triage, clinical decision, imaging, patient interaction, drug discovery, monitoring, surgical — route and collaborate

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does a medical query enter the LangGraph state graph?')
sendPrompt('How does the adaptive router decide which medical agent to invoke?')
sendPrompt('How does the clinical decision support agent analyze patient data?')
sendPrompt('How does the patient interaction agent handle appointment scheduling?')
sendPrompt('How does the imaging agent detect anomalies in X-rays and MRIs?')
sendPrompt('How does the drug discovery agent simulate molecular interactions?')
sendPrompt('How does the remote monitoring agent detect early patient deterioration?')
sendPrompt('What vector search tools are available to medical agents?')
sendPrompt('How does web search help medical agents find the latest evidence?')
sendPrompt('How does the code search tool support the imaging and drug agents?')
sendPrompt('How does the camera and WebRTC tool stream video for monitoring?')
sendPrompt('How does the document grader score and filter agent outputs?')
sendPrompt('What safety checks happen before a medical AI response is sent?')
sendPrompt('How does the tracer log each step of the medical agent workflow?')
sendPrompt('How is the final response delivered to Flutter mobile and React web?')
